description: Add BOM TypeScript interfaces and enums to src/types/database.ts, create bomStore with loading/fetching logic, and add BOM display components (MasterBomTable, ActualBomTable, FinalBomTable, BomReconciliationView, BomStatusBadge) with integration into App.tsx.
steps: Step 1: Add BOM enums and interfaces to src/types/database.ts. Add enums: MasterBomStatus ('GENERATED'|'VALIDATED'|'APPROVED'|'INVALIDATED'), ActualBomStatus ('GENERATED'|'VALIDATED'|'SUPERSEDED'), ReconciliationResultType ('UNCHANGED'|'QUANTITY_CHANGED'|'SKU_CHANGED'|'REMOVED'|'ADDED_BY_TRIGGER'|'UNEXPECTED'). Add interfaces matching DB columns: MasterBom (master_bom_id, template_id, status, generated_at, engine_version, rule_set_id, approved_by, approved_at, created_at), MasterBomLine (master_bom_line_id, master_bom_id, template_component_id, sku_id, product_type, source_zone_id, source_relationship_id, quantity_rule, default_quantity, unit_of_measure, mandatory, hidden, calculation_parameters, parent_bom_line_id, created_at), ActualBom (actual_bom_id, project_id, snapshot_id, configuration_id, status, engine_version, rule_set_id, input_hash, calculation_timestamp), ActualBomLine (actual_bom_line_id, actual_bom_id, master_bom_line_id, component_id, sku_id, product_type, quantity, required_quantity, waste_factor, waste_quantity, unit_of_measure, resolved_dimensions, calculation_rule, calculation_inputs), FinalBom (final_bom_id, project_id, actual_bom_id, final_bom_hash, engine_version, rule_set_id, input_hash, finalized_at, finalized_by), FinalBomLine (final_bom_line_id, final_bom_id, actual_bom_line_id, sku_id, sku_code, product_type, sku_material, sku_colour, sku_finish, sku_dimensions_json, source_zone_id, source_component_id, quantity, required_quantity, waste_quantity, unit_of_measure, resolved_dimensions, source_trace). Add ReconciliationLine interface with fields: master_line, actual_line, result_type.

Step 2: Create src/stores/bomStore.ts following the pattern in skuStore.ts. State: masterBom (MasterBom | null), masterBomLines (MasterBomLine[]), actualBom (ActualBom | null), actualBomLines (ActualBomLine[]), finalBom (FinalBom | null), finalBomLines (FinalBomLine[]), reconciliation (ReconciliationLine[]), isLoading, error, isBomPanelOpen. Actions: fetchMasterBom(templateId: string) - queries master_bom where template_id=templateId and status='APPROVED' (single), then master_bom_line where master_bom_id. fetchActualBom(projectId: string) - queries actual_bom where project_id=projectId and status != 'SUPERSEDED' order by calculation_timestamp desc limit 1, then actual_bom_line. fetchFinalBom(projectId: string) - queries final_bom where project_id=projectId (unique constraint), then final_bom_line. computeReconciliation() - compares masterBomLines to actualBomLines by master_bom_line_id, assigns result types. openBomPanel(), closeBomPanel(). resetBom().

Step 3: Create src/components/BomPanel/ directory with: index.ts (barrel export), BomPanel.tsx (container component similar to SkuBrowser - fixed overlay panel, 600px wide, renders MasterBomTable in DESIGNER mode, ActualBomTable + FinalBomTable in CONSULTANT mode), BomStatusBadge.tsx (small colored badge for status values - green for APPROVED, blue for GENERATED, orange for VALIDATED, red for INVALIDATED/SUPERSEDED), BomSectionTable.tsx (reusable table grouped by product_type sections: WALL_PANEL, LIGHT, FURNITURE with summary/totals row per section).

Step 4: Create MasterBomTable.tsx in src/components/BomPanel/. Shows master BOM lines grouped by product_type (Wall Panel, Light, Furniture sections). Columns: SKU Code, Quantity Rule, Default Qty, Unit, Zone Source, Mandatory. Include a totals row per section showing count of items. Uses BomSectionTable for layout.

Step 5: Create ActualBomTable.tsx in src/components/BomPanel/. Shows actual BOM lines grouped by product_type. Columns: SKU Code, Quantity, Required Qty, Waste Factor, Waste Qty, Unit, Calculation Rule. Include totals row per section. Note per spec section 91: same SKU in multiple zones stays as separate lines.

Step 6: Create FinalBomTable.tsx in src/components/BomPanel/. Shows final BOM lines grouped by product_type. Columns: SKU Code, Material, Colour, Finish, Qty, Required, Waste, Unit. Display immutability indicator (lock icon or badge). Shows denormalized SKU data. Include totals row per section.

Step 7: Create BomReconciliationView.tsx in src/components/BomPanel/. Compares Master vs Actual BOM. Shows each line with its reconciliation result type (UNCHANGED, QUANTITY_CHANGED, SKU_CHANGED, REMOVED, ADDED_BY_TRIGGER, UNEXPECTED) using color coding. Only visible when both masterBomLines and actualBomLines are loaded.

Step 8: Wire BomPanel into App.tsx. Add a 'BOM' button to the header (next to Designer/Consultant mode buttons) that opens the BOM panel. Import useBomStore and BomPanel. Conditionally render BomPanel when isBomPanelOpen is true. The button triggers openBomPanel() and also calls fetchMasterBom or fetchActualBom/fetchFinalBom depending on current mode and loaded template/project.

Step 9: Create tests in src/stores/__tests__/bomStore.test.ts following the pattern in skuStore.test.ts. Test: initial state, fetchMasterBom sets loading/calls fromTable with correct params, fetchActualBom, fetchFinalBom, computeReconciliation logic (test each result type), openBomPanel/closeBomPanel, error handling.

Step 10: Create tests in src/components/BomPanel/__tests__/BomPanel.test.tsx following the SkuBrowser test pattern. Test: renders in DESIGNER mode showing MasterBomTable, renders in CONSULTANT mode showing ActualBomTable and FinalBomTable, BomStatusBadge renders correct colors, section grouping by product_type works, totals row shows correct counts, reconciliation view shows result type badges, close button works.
acceptance_criteria: TypeScript interfaces for all 6 BOM tables exist in src/types/database.ts with correct field types
bomStore exports useBomStore with fetch actions for master/actual/final BOM and reconciliation computation
BomPanel renders MasterBomTable in DESIGNER mode and ActualBomTable + FinalBomTable in CONSULTANT mode
Tables are grouped by product_type sections (Wall Panel, Light, Furniture) with summary/totals rows
BomStatusBadge correctly renders colored badges for each status value
BomReconciliationView shows comparison results with correct result type classification
App.tsx has a BOM button that opens the panel and triggers data fetching based on mode
All existing 107 tests continue to pass
New bomStore tests pass covering state management and fetch logic
New BomPanel component tests pass covering rendering in both modes
npx tsc --noEmit passes with zero errors
